description: This file is a shell script used for backing up logs, managing reboots, and coordinating system maintenance tasks in an embedded device or router environment. It includes functions for log handling, system notifications, and reboot procedures.

methods.name: backupLogsonReboot
methods.description: Backs up logs during a system reboot, including copying log files, creating system descriptors, and optionally syncing with an external server.

methods.name: backupLogsonReboot_nvram2
methods.description: Performs log backup during reboot with additional handling for nvram2 supported devices, including telemetry notification and log cleanup.

methods.name: backup_log_pidCleanup
methods.description: Removes the log upload PID file to clean up process state.

methods.name: getTFTPServer
methods.description: Retrieves the TFTP log server address based on build type.

methods.name: Trigger_RebootPendingNotify
methods.description: Sets a reboot pending notification via dmcli before system reboot.

methods.name: getBuildType
methods.description: Determines the build type (DEV, VBN, PROD, CQA) from /version.txt.
